description: Repository policy for required-status-checks on the default branch. This is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for what merge protection should require. scripts/check_required_checks_drift.py compares this against the live branch-protection/ruleset configuration (or a committed snapshot) and fails when the live configuration no longer requires everything listed here. See issue #1119.

required_contexts.reason: Fail-closed aggregate for frontend scope, typecheck, Vitest, performance and applicable E2E checks. PR #2287 merged despite failed Vitest because the Python quality-gate did not cover this workflow. Apply the supplement only after this job is available on main.
Lint/format/type-check/placeholder gate. Already enforced; kept here so the policy file is a complete statement of intent.

Aggregate pytest gate. PR #1116 merged despite a failing 'tests (3.11)' matrix leg because the aggregate 'tests' job (tests-required in ci-standard.yml) has no `if: always()` guard: when its `needs: [tests]` dependency fails, GitHub Actions skips tests-required by default, and a SKIPPED conclusion on a required check does not block merge. The context name is already required at the branch-protection level, but the job that reports it is not fail-closed. See scripts/check_required_checks_drift.py:check_job_fails_closed for the corresponding static check on ci-standard.yml.

PR #1118 (docs-only) merged while this check was still QUEUED. The 'guard' context is not present in either the classic branch-protection required_status_checks.contexts list or the 'Repository_Protections' ruleset's required_status_checks parameters, so GitHub never waited for it. This is the primary gap closed by issue #1119: add 'guard' to the required-status-checks list (classic protection and/or the ruleset) for the main branch.

Frontend type safety gate. The job must always report this context (heavy steps gated per-step) so docs-only PRs and merge_group runs never leave the check Expected. Applied on main via config/repository_rulesets/required-status-checks-supplement.json.

Baseline diff secret scan. Must run on fork PRs (ubuntu-latest) and on merge_group so required protection never waits for a missing context. Applied on main via config/repository_rulesets/required-status-checks-supplement.json.

Fails when frontend/src/lib/openapi.json or api-types.ts drift from a fresh OpenAPI export. Complements Frontend Tests typecheck; applies on merge_group so backend-only PRs cannot merge with a stale contract.

merge_queue.reason: Repository_Management#1890 / #1900: the merge queue re-tests each PR against the latest main before merging, replacing strict up-to-date protection and bulk PR branch updates. Every workflow reporting a context above must trigger on merge_group (tests/test_workflow_hygiene.py).
